style: polished cartoon, smooth anti-aliased (not pixel art), 3/4 top-down world

specs.boot_storyboard: 1 pod blink (intro_pod_blink) -> 2 intro_pod_open + intro_flash@04 + intro_steam_burst@05, casings fall (intro_shell_spin, bounce in code, intro_glint on impact) -> 3 casings fly into place, intro_logo appears + intro_logo_shine -> 4 点击开始 over intro_title_bg (text is UI code).
specs.canvas_contract: One frame size + anchor per animation set: pod 640x640@(320,610); shell 256x256@(128,128); flash/steam 512x512; glint 128x128; logo 1600x640@(800,320); bg 1920x1080@(0,0).
specs.build: python art_src/intro_build.py && python art_src/intro_fixes_verify.py (run after the stage-2 chain).
specs.soft_alpha: FX, steam and logo shadow use intentional soft alpha (flagged intentional_soft_alpha).

assets.name: intro_logo
assets.purpose: Typeset title 弹壳轮回 + SHELL REBIRTH (NotoSansCJK SC Bold / Black Ops One), brass + gunmetal bevel, dark outline, drop shadow. Exact glyphs from fonts.
assets.subtitle: SHELL REBIRTH

assets.name: intro_logo_shine
assets.purpose: One-shot metallic glint sweeping across the logo (full composited frames, same canvas/anchor as intro_logo). End on intro_logo.

assets.name: intro_shell_spin
assets.purpose: Brass casing tumbling end-over-end in 3D (shows primer base and open mouth), 30°/frame, fixed upper-left light. Translate the sprite in code for falls and bounces.
assets.method: 3D tumble: orthographic raymarch of a solid-of-revolution casing, 30°/frame about a tilted axis, cel shading, fixed upper-left world light; per-frame alpha-centroid registration

assets.name: intro_shell_rest
assets.purpose: Settled casing (for the logo formation / floor scatter). Same canvas/anchor as intro_shell_spin.

assets.name: intro_flash
assets.purpose: Bright warm burst + cyan shock ring (pod unlatch / logo slam). Additive blend recommended.

assets.name: intro_glint
assets.purpose: Small four-point metal sparkle; pop on casings/logo edges.

assets.name: intro_steam_burst
assets.purpose: One-shot cartoon steam burst rising from the pod vent; anchor = emitter (bottom centre).

assets.name: intro_steam_loop
assets.purpose: Seamless lingering steam loop, same canvas/anchor as the burst.

assets.name: intro_pod_blink
assets.purpose: Closed Echo Pod (回响舱), indicator lights blink in the dark (beat 1). Same canvas/anchor as intro_pod_open.
assets.method: first frame of the generated pod clip with its cyan emitters dimmed/brightened per frame

assets.name: intro_pod_open
assets.purpose: Echo Pod door unlatch (04 jolt) and the armored double door splits and swings open on side hinges, revealing the glowing cyan chamber with a revived silhouette; hold last frame. Spawn intro_flash at 04 and intro_steam_burst at 05.
assets.method: Grok image-to-video (grok-imagine-video-1.5) of the generated closed pod art_src/intro/raw/echo_pod_closed.png; 16 of 73 keyed frames, one rigid scale 0.66 + offset; frames 00-03 carry the blink light levels
assets.fallback: INTRO_FALLBACK=1 -> editorial rig of echo_pod_master (door swung per column)

assets.name: intro_title_bg
assets.purpose: Title-screen background 1920x1080 (=960x540 logical x DPR2). Dedicated generated key art: glowing Echo Pod with steam, brass casings scattered on the bunker floor; upper-middle darkened for intro_logo. Opaque.
assets.method: dedicated Grok-generated key art (art_src/intro/raw/title_bg.png via intro_fixes_generate.py), resized + logo-band darkening
assets.fallback: INTRO_FALLBACK=1 -> composite of base_tinshack_bg + procedural casings
